name: Washington
gaps: Geometry and owner are Tennessee OIR Tennessee Property Boundaries Public Use, edited 2026-09-10, filtered by Comptroller COUNTY_ID. Acreage is the geodesic area of the polygon because DEEDAC is often 0. The filter is 5.0–150.0 acres inclusive. Vertices are not simplified.

Sale date, sale price, and appraisal are joined from the card sales-value layer (https://services3.arcgis.com/nLnrKGwI08veJ5uu/arcgis/rest/services/Parcels/FeatureServer/0/query) on GISLINK and labeled 2026 when a value is present. A GISLINK with no match is left without sale or value. The 2023 TN_County_Parcel_Map sibling is not the sale source. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
The property-record link is LINK_TPAD when the OIR row publishes it, otherwise the TPAD GIS card for the same GISLINK. Opportunity Zone status was not inferred.
Regrid and other paid parcel vendors were not used.

Zoning comes from the card's usable zoning layers. A parcel-id layer is joined on that id. Polygon layers are stamped by centroid, and a later city layer replaces an earlier code only inside that city. Outside those layers zoning stays empty.
